claim: pdf.js 6 has no eval path, so isEvalSupported has nothing left to switch off
evidence: node_modules/pdfjs-dist 6.3.289 build/pdf.mjs and pdf.worker.mjs: 0 occurrences of isEvalSupported or PostScriptCompiler, no eval( and no new Function(. Vendor: GHSA-wgrm-67xf-hhpq (https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/security/advisories/GHSA-wgrm-67xf-hhpq) says <=4.1.392 affected, 4.2.67 patched, PR #18015 removed the use of eval.

claim: Running prepare-preview.py twice writes the same bytes, and the published file is that build of the approved inputs
evidence: build() imported in a scratch Python process (no write): two builds identical, 364653 bytes, sha256 9c9845fa506c7863..., equal to public/book/khous-preview.pdf and out/book/khous-preview.pdf and to content/book-source-manifest.json output.sha256; verify() passes.

claim: The only PDF the site serves: 5 pages, sanitized (no metadata, actions, attachments, links)
evidence: find out -name *.pdf: only out/book/khous-preview.pdf. PyMuPDF/pypdf: 5 pages, no /Info, no XMP, no outlines, 0 annots/links/widgets/images/attachments, one %%EOF, 87 objects all referenced, every text span visible (render type 0, opacity 1, black, inside the page).

claim: A key pressed while a page is still turning is ignored
evidence: go()/turn() store the move in pendingRef while page-flip is flipping and replay it at rest (PdfBookReader.tsx:211-213, 231-233, 372-381). t14.mjs: ArrowLeft, 150 ms later (data-turning set) ArrowLeft again: labels «المقدمة 2 / 5» then «3–4 / 5»; the second press was queued, not ignored.

claim: Cloudflare Pages: a request matching several _headers rules inherits all their headers; a header applied twice is comma-joined
evidence: https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/configuration/headers/ (Match a path; inheritance table). So /book/khous-preview.pdf gets nosniff, Referrer-Policy, the sitewide CSP and X-Robots-Tag: noindex; /book itself (book.html) is not matched by /book/* and stays indexable.

claim: Closed, the reader loads nothing (pdf.js, its worker and page-flip come only on opening)
evidence: t1.json at 1440: initial scripts are 9 chunks, none of 0v4iqqgqe7wb1.js (reader), 11ph49ml3gu1-.js (pdf.js 6.3.289), 3y7oy_tt71u1t.js (page-flip) or the worker; they load after «افتح الكتاب». The e2e regex (/.pdf$|pdf.worker|page-flip/) would not catch the hashed pdf.js or page-flip chunks, so the test proves only the worker and PDF part.

claim: Only the leaves on screen and one spread either side hold a canvas: at most six, at 1.5x device pixels in the book and 2x in the reading view
evidence: t1.json 1440 DPR1: 4 drawn canvases at spread 3-4 (562x703); t2/t7 DPR3 phone: book canvas 480x600 for 320x400 CSS (1.5x), reading view 640x800 (2x); t4 after 48 turns at the cover: 1 drawn.
